biotools.summary: Local Windows-friendly R Shiny application for RNA-seq differential expression using DESeq2, normalized-expression testing, over-representation analysis, fgsea-ranked pathway analysis, and WGCNA coexpression-network analysis. It supports input validation, additive and interaction designs, built-in human, fruit-fly, and yeast annotations, publication-quality plots, and reproducibility bundles containing results, settings, and executable R and R Markdown rerun code.
